name: BizPilot AI
tagline: AI-native operations workspace for small businesses: customer Q&A, quotes, invoices, orders, and follow-ups.
description:
BizPilot AI is an AI-native front-office and back-office operations workspace built for small businesses on Anna AI OS.

Core Features:
• Front Desk (Customer Q&A): Paste any customer inquiry to generate a reply grounded strictly in your verified product catalog, FAQs, and order history—with prompt-injection boundaries and one-click quote creation.
• Quotes & Invoices: Draft quotes and invoices from plain natural language or a structured line-item builder. All subtotals, discounts, taxes, and grand totals are computed deterministically with Decimal precision, with one-click Quote-to-Invoice conversion and Print/PDF export.
• Order Pipeline: Track fulfillment stages (Pending → In Progress → Ready → Completed / Cancelled) with validated state transitions and AI-drafted customer status updates.
• Smart Follow-Ups: Automatically surfaces sent quotes and unpaid or overdue invoices ranked by age and priority, drafting personalized follow-up messages for human-in-the-loop review before sending.
• Business Brain: Centralized workspace for your company profile, ISO 4217 currency, tax rate, payment instructions, catalog, and FAQs stored securely in your isolated Anna AI OS storage.

Built natively for Anna AI OS with zero external network origins, automatic light/dark theme sync, and a multi-platform Executa toolset discoverable by both the UI and other Anna AI agents.
